description: The RePP Africa research team publishes a georeferenced inventory of existing, under-construction and proposed renewable power plants across Africa. The own collection description reports 1,074 hydropower, 1,128 solar and 282 wind records as of November 2022. Attributes include coordinates, country, status and capacity, with operating type for many hydro plants and all solar plants. A single Excel workbook has eleven sheets containing metadata, technology-specific tables and sources, with at least two references reported per record. The Figshare item is free under CC0. Modellers can use the inventory for capacity expansion or asset-exposure simulations and compare it with data-gem-global-wind-power-tracker and data-gem-global-hydropower-tracker. A caveat is that planned capacity is not operating capacity, and proposal status may change after the snapshot. The wind count differs from the paper abstract, which reports 276; this record follows the repository metadata, not claiming to reconcile the workbook. No workbook was downloaded.
